title: WESTERN HEMISPHERE COMMAND (WHC) SUSTAINABLE RANGE PROGRAM (SRP) SINGLE AWARD TASK ORDER CONTRACT (SATOC)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST SAVANNAH.W074 ENDIST SAVANNAH
description_text: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Savannah District intends to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP) (W912HN26RA020) for $49M Western Hemisphere Command (WHC) Sustainable Range Program (SRP) Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC)Note: This Pre-Solicitation notice is ONLY A NOTIFICATION that a solicitation is anticipated and forthcoming; no proposals are being accepted at this time.Type of Set-Aside: This acquisition is being offered as a 100% set-aside for small business competition, under NAICS 541330, and will result in a Firm Fixed Price Contract Award.Anticipated Solicitation Release Date: The Government anticipates releasing the solicitation on or about 17 July 2026. Please note that actual dates and times will be identified in the solicitation. Additional details can be found in the solicitation when it is posted.Total Ordering Period: The SATOC will have an ordering period of Five (5) years.Description of Work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Savannah District, in support of the (U.S. Army Training Support Systems Execution Commands (ACOM?s) including Western Hemisphere Command (WHC) (formally known as FORSCOM), U.S. Army Reserve (USARC), and U.S. Special Operations Command (USASOC)), requires contractor support to provide engineering, technical, and program management services in support of the Army?s training support infrastructure and the Sustainable Range Program (SRP).The contractor shall provide all personnel, supervision, equipment, materials, and other resources necessary to perform non-personal services supporting the planning, assessment, modernization, sustainment, and management of Army training ranges and training support systems. Services to be performed under this contract may include, but are not limited to: ? Engineering and technical support for training range planning, modernization, and sustainment initiatives ? Technical support for the Live Fire Training Investment Strategy (LFTIS) and other range modernization programs ? Range capability assessments and infrastructure evaluations ? Engineering analysis and planning support for range modernization and sustainment projects ? Environmental and regulatory coordination associated with training range operations ? Development of technical studies, reports, and planning documentation related to range sustainment and modernization ? Program management and technical support for Sustainable Range Program initiatives ? Technical support for range instrumentation, targetry systems, and training support infrastructure ? Data analysis, modeling, and reporting related to range capability, utilization, and sustainment planning These services support the Army?s objective of maximizing the capability, availability, and accessibility of training ranges and training lands in order to meet doctrinal training requirements while maintaining environmental stewardship and compliance with applicable regulations.Solicitation Website: The official solicitation is available free of charge by electronic posting only and may be found at System of Award Management System (SAM) website, https://sam.gov. Paper copies of the solicitation will not be issued. Telephone and Fax requests for this solicitation will not be honored. Project files are Portable Document Format (PDF) files and can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. To download the solicitation for this project, contractors are required to register at the SAM website at https://sam.gov. Amendments, if/when issued, will be posted to the above referenced website for electronic downloading. This will be the only method of distributing amendments prior to closing; therefore, it is the Offerors responsibility to check the website periodically for any amendments to the solicitation.Registrations: Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the following database:System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at https://sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award. If the Offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity shall have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. If at the time of award an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror.Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE): The only authorized transmission method for proposals in response to the forthcoming solicitation is electronically via Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. No Other Transmission Method (E-mail, Facsimile, U.S. Postal Mail, Hand Carried, etc.) Will Be Accepted. Offerors must have an active Proposal Manager role in PIEE at https://piee.eb.mil/.
